identity_and_disambiguation: Operating/public name: Charleston GI Specialists / Charleston GI; the official site is https://charlestongi.com. The practice describes itself as “the first and largest independent group of GI specialists in Charleston” and says it has “eleven outstanding board-certified gastroenterologists” and “four convenient locations and two state-of-the-art endoscopy centers.” URL: https://charlestongi.com/ . Public NPI-directory evidence identifies “Charleston Gastroenterology Specialists” as an organization at “1962 Charlie Hall Blvd, Charleston, SC 29414-5837”; the same result names Sherry M. Searson as “BUSINESS SERVICES MANAGER.” URL: https://opengovus.com/npi/1205835865 . Apollo-supplied firmographics report founded 2002, 76 employees, HQ 1962 Charlie Hall Blvd, and phone +1 843-722-8000, but those supplied firmographics were not independently verified in the indexed public sources. Legal entity type, SC Secretary of State filing, EIN, organizational NPI details beyond the directory result, and official LinkedIn URL are NOT FOUND in the reviewed public evidence. DISAMBIGUATION: This dossier is limited to the entity operating https://charlestongi.com. It must not be confused with MUSC Health/Medical University of South Carolina GI, Roper St. Francis GI, Lowcountry Gastroenterology, Trident/Summerville hospital GI, or national platforms. A Roper page is explicitly labeled “Roper St. Francis Healthcare” even though it lists Charleston Gastroenterology Specialists locations; it is not treated as ownership evidence for Charleston GI. URL: https://datamanager-roperstfrancis.consumerism.pressganey.com/default/details/495?Practices=601%2C906%2C607%2C961%2C869%2C1152%2C1704%2C1705%2C1490%2C685&SetSize=48&SortBy=FamilyName&SortDirection=Asc&tab=2&tab=2&view=tiled .

Hospital privileges are not evidence of ownership and none are attributed here.
ownership_and_independence: Charleston GI publicly self-identifies as independent: “the first and largest independent group of GI specialists in Charleston.” URL: https://charlestongi.com/ . Its December 29, 2025 article says, “At Charleston GI, we’re proud to maintain a local, patient-centered focus” and “Charleston GI remains committed to being a trusted, independent resource.” URL: https://charlestongi.com/news&events/navigating-the-changing-gi-investment-landscape-what-it-means-for-you/ . The Summerville project source describes the group as “a private physicians group.” URL: https://www.gmka.com/charleston-gastro-specialists . INFERENCE: The public evidence supports a locally independent/private physician-group posture, but does not prove the exact equity holders or legal ownership chain. No acquisition or partnership announcement involving GI Alliance, United Digestive, One GI, Gastro Health, or a PE/MSO parent was found in the reviewed sources; therefore PE/MSO affiliation: NOT FOUND, not a definitive negative.

A public statement explicitly assigning prior-authorization/pre-certification work to named staff or a job posting: NOT FOUND. The doctors page says “Schedule an appointment 5 days a week, no referral needed!” URL: https://charlestongi.com/doctors-and-staff/ .
